seo.title: ITMAP | AI-native vendor selection
seo.description: Explore the ITMAP platform: vendor scoring, feature evaluations, market forecasts, news intelligence, and conversational AI — all in one enterprise-grade workspace.

hero.subtitle: Six deeply integrated capabilities — from vendor maps to custom evaluation frameworks — built around one principle: give enterprise buyers the truth about technology.

methodology.title: How we produce research you can trust
methodology.description: Our methodology is designed to eliminate bias at every stage — from data ingestion through scoring to publication. Every decision in the pipeline is documented and auditable.

continuousDataIngestion.title: Continuous Data Ingestion
continuousDataIngestion.description: Our pipeline monitors thousands of public sources: vendor websites, press releases, GitHub repositories, SEC filings, job postings, patent databases and news feeds.

llmPoweredScoring.title: LLM-Powered Scoring
llmPoweredScoring.description: Large language models evaluate each data point against our 40+ dimension scoring rubric. Scores are weighted, validated and aggregated into vendor positions.

structuredOutput.title: Structured Output
structuredOutput.description: Results are structured into a normalised data model covering scores, feature support flags, news impact events and narrative insights — all queryable by users.

expertReviewLayer.title: Expert Review Layer
expertReviewLayer.description: Our team of IT practitioners reviews model outputs for accuracy, applies domain corrections and ensures the research reflects real-world operational reality.

buyerTools.title: Every tool a Technology Buyer needs
buyerTools.description: All of these capabilities are unlocked for Technology Buyers and end users — no tiers, no paywalls, no vendor influence.

vendorEvaluationMaps.title: Vendor Evaluation Maps
vendorEvaluationMaps.description: Interactive quadrant visualizations positioning vendors across execution and product strength.

featureSupportMatrix.title: Feature Support Matrix
featureSupportMatrix.description: Side-by-side comparison across hundreds of product capabilities and dimensions.

newsIntelligenceFeed.title: News & Intelligence Feed
newsIntelligenceFeed.description: AI-scored news, funding, product launches, and market signals with impact ratings.

researchReports.title: Research Reports
researchReports.description: Deep-dive market and vendor reports, continuously updated and exportable as PDFs.

marketBuilder.title: Market Builder
marketBuilder.description: Define custom criteria and weights to generate a ranking tailored to your needs.

datasheets.title: Datasheets
datasheets.description: Compare vendor datasheets, specifications, and feature claims in one place.

rfpBuilder.title: RFP Builder
rfpBuilder.description: Generate RFPs from market data, scoring criteria, and vendor requirements.

forecastBuilder.title: Forecast Builder
forecastBuilder.description: Model market trajectories and forecast vendor positioning over time.

battleCards.title: Battle Cards
battleCards.description: Competitive positioning cards to compare vendors for internal decision-making.

cveIntelligence.title: CVE Intelligence
cveIntelligence.description: Security vulnerability tracking and risk signals for evaluated vendors.

factReview.title: Fact Review
factReview.description: Collaborate on flagging and verifying research facts with the ITMAP team.

aiChat.title: AI Chat
aiChat.description: Conversational assistant that answers questions about any market or vendor.

cta.title: Experience it for yourself
cta.description: Free access to all markets, vendor maps and feature matrices. No credit card required.
